title: Resume for job applications.
description: Structured resume data used to generate HTML resumes, cover letters, and fitness evaluations for job applications. Loosely based on the JSON Resume schema (https://jsonresume.org).

basics.description: Core personal and contact details displayed in the profile header of the resume.

headline.description: Primary professional title or role, displayed as the headline beneath the name (e.g., 'Full Stack Software Developer').

image.description: Filename of the profile photo located in the '.dist/' output directory (e.g., 'profile.jpeg').

phone.description: Primary contact phone number, including country code (e.g., '+4525113899').

summary.description: Multiline 'About' text providing a brief overview of the candidate's background, expertise, and current focus. Newlines separate paragraphs in the rendered output.

skills.description: A short list of top-level headline skills displayed as pills in the 'About' section. Keep this concise (3-5 items) to highlight key strengths. Distinct from the root-level 'skills' array, which is the comprehensive list.

location.description: Current geographic location of the candidate, shown in the profile header.

region.description: State, province, or region (e.g., 'Central Denmark Region').

countryCode.description: Country name or ISO country code (e.g., 'Denmark').

social.description: Links to social media and professional profiles, rendered as buttons in the profile header.

username.description: Username or handle on the platform. Also used to construct URLs (e.g., LinkedIn recommendations link).

url.description: Full URL to the profile page.

work.description: Professional work experience entries, ordered from most recent to oldest. Consecutive entries with the same company name are automatically grouped under a single company heading with multiple sub-roles in the rendered output.

name.description: Company or organization name. Consecutive entries sharing the same name are grouped together visually.

location.description: Location of the role (e.g., 'Brande, Central Denmark Region, Denmark').

position.description: Job title held at the company (e.g., 'Full Stack Software Developer').

startDate.description: Start date of the position in 'YYYY-MM' format (e.g., '2025-11').

endDate.description: End date of the position in 'YYYY-MM' format, or an empty string if the position is current (renders as 'Present').

summary.description: Brief free-text description of the role. Rendered as a paragraph. Can be empty if highlights cover the role sufficiently.

highlights.description: Key accomplishments and responsibilities, rendered as a bulleted list.

skills.description: Technologies, tools, and competencies used in this role, rendered as skill pills.

mediaLinks.description: Attached media items (images, documents, links) from the LinkedIn entry.

url.description: Full URL of the linked resource.

logoUrl.description: URL to the company logo image (typically a LinkedIn company logo). Falls back to a placeholder initial if empty.

education.description: Academic history entries, ordered from most recent to oldest.

name.description: Name of the educational institution (e.g., 'Aarhus University').

area.description: Field of study or degree program (e.g., 'Computer Science (4 semesters)'). Can be empty for institutions where a specific program is not applicable.

studyType.description: Type of degree or supplementary context about the program (e.g., 'Bachelor', 'Master'). Can be empty.

startDate.description: Start date of the education in 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM' format.

endDate.description: End date of the education in 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM' format, or empty string if ongoing.

courses.description: List of notable courses completed during the program, rendered as a comma-separated list.

skills.description: Skills and technologies acquired during the education, rendered as skill pills.

mediaLinks.description: Attached media items (images, documents, links) from the LinkedIn entry.

url.description: Full URL of the linked resource.

logoUrl.description: URL to the institution's logo image. Falls back to a placeholder initial if empty.

projects.description: Notable personal, open-source, or professional side projects.

description.description: Brief description of the project's purpose and scope.

highlights.description: Key features or accomplishments, rendered as a bulleted list.

skills.description: Technologies and skills used in the project, rendered as skill pills.

startDate.description: Start date of the project in 'YYYY-MM' format.

endDate.description: End date of the project in 'YYYY-MM' format, or empty string if ongoing.

roles.description: Roles held within the project (e.g., 'Lead Developer', 'Maintainer').

entity.description: Company or organization the project is associated with, rendered as 'Associated with <entity>'. Empty for personal projects.

type.description: Category or type of project (e.g., 'Open Source', 'Internal Tool'). Can be empty.

url.description: Primary URL for the project (e.g., GitHub repository). Can be empty.

mediaLinks.description: Additional external links related to the project (e.g., Spotify, demo sites), rendered as link buttons.

title.description: Display text for the link (e.g., 'GitHub - bemoje/mono', 'Spotify').

url.description: Full URL of the linked resource.

logoUrl.description: URL to a project logo or thumbnail image. Falls back to a placeholder initial if empty.

fluency.description: Proficiency level (e.g., 'Native or bilingual proficiency', 'Professional working proficiency').

recommendations.description: Professional recommendations received, typically from LinkedIn. Rendered with a link to the LinkedIn recommendations page.

name.description: Full name of the person who gave the recommendation.

headline.description: Professional headline or job title of the recommender (e.g., 'Delivery Director FO at Evidi').

date.description: Date the recommendation was given, in human-readable format (e.g., 'June 13, 2025').

relationship.description: Professional relationship between the recommender and the candidate (e.g., 'Martin managed Benjamin directly').

logoUrl.description: URL to the recommender's profile photo. Falls back to a placeholder initial if empty.

skills.description: Comprehensive list of all professional skills, typically scraped from LinkedIn. Rendered as a flat list of skill pills in the 'Skills' section. Distinct from 'basics.skills', which is only the top headline skills.

associations.description: Contexts where the skill was demonstrated or acquired - work positions, education, projects, endorsements, or LinkedIn skill assessments.
